Home About Model Search We’re looking for the next face of Seacoast Plastic Surgery & Medical Aesthetics. Are you starting to notice changes in your skin—and unsure what to do next? If you’re dealing with: Brown spots / sun damage Melasma or patchy discoloration Redness, flushing, or visible capillaries Acne scarring or rough texture Lines and wrinkles that makeup settles into …this may be the perfect opportunity for you. Global Skin Rejuvenation Model Program We’re selecting a small group of women (ages 35–55) for a full-spectrum, non-surgical skin rejuvenation journey —guided by our team and customized to your goals. Selected models may receive a personalized combination of: Injectables to refine balance and support facial harmony Laser treatments to improve pigmentation (sun spots/discoloration), redness (flushing/broken capillaries), fine lines, and acne scarring/texture Medical-grade skincare for daily maintenance and long-term results Professional facials to enhance outcomes and support skin health Program details & requirements Women ages 35–55 Must live within 30 miles of Portsmouth, NH Multiple appointments required Weekday availability needed (Monday–Friday) Photos and short videos captured throughout the process (for educational and marketing purposes) Ready to be considered? Apply online below. If selected, our team will contact you with next steps. Please attach 3 photos taken in natural lighting (front-facing and both side profiles, taken at arm’s length).
